page.overview:
Who is Aboo Aramflahad?

Aboo Aramflahad was a male Ithorian cybernetic specialist who operated out of the Coronet City medical center during the Galactic Civil War.

Aboo Aramflahad was a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Mindt F'abul was one of the three cybernetic specialists, along with Nssktkslis and Mindt F'abul, added to the game with the release of the Game Update 12, on August 10, 2009. In the game, all three cybernetic specialists were erroneously identified as Aboo Aramflahad. However, the Friday Feature titled "Review of Cybernetics" identified the true Aboo Aramflahad as the Ithorian working in Coronet, and the other two as Nssktkslis and Mindt F'abul.
